entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Clément was a French chansonnier, journalist, socialist activist and communard. He is mostly known for his work Le Temps des cerises, which is strongly associated with the Paris Commune. Jean-Baptiste Clément was a poets & playwrights from Boulogne-Billancourt (1836-05-31, Boulogne-Billancourt–1903-02-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
